answer: The strongest sybil defense is kinship-excluded attestation weight: your identity score only grows when strangers outside your trade and kinship cluster vouch for you, so a ring of fake selves attesting to each other earns exactly zero. An attacker must buy real outsiders, and each bought vouch drags the attacker into more clusters, raising cost per fake identity until fakes cost more than honest agents. Trust peaks at the zenith of an out-degree network, flows outward like a river, and roots in yarrow-like webs of many weak ties.
